paragraphs: EasyVote Solutions sells software that modernizes election administration, designed specifically for election offices. The buyers are city, county and state election offices. One module handles poll worker scheduling, training, communication and performance tracking in one system.

Poll worker records cover each worker's work history, training and performance. An asset tracking module combines tracking, chain of custody, GPS tracking of equipment, and reporting and audit history. Inventory management covers supplies during all phases of an election, before, during and after. A campaign finance module includes a public-facing portal that makes campaign finance disclosures easy to search and access. The platform is built on Microsoft Azure.

The company says more than 350 jurisdictions serving communities of all sizes use it. It was built by former election officials. Support staff are described as experts in both technical support and election knowledge. Pricing and licensing agreements are simple and do not require a long-term commitment.

quote.text: EasyVote is modernizing election administration with technology designed specifically for election offices.
